Class AllureManager

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.tools.io.internal.AllureManager
public class AllureManager extends Object
Internal utility class that manages the Allure reporting lifecycle for SHAFT test runs. Responsibilities include initialising the results directory, optionally generating an allurerc.yaml configuration file, bootstrapping the Allure 3 CLI (downloaded automatically when not present), invoking it to produce the HTML report, and optionally producing a ZIP archive.

This class is not intended for direct use in test code. It is invoked automatically by the SHAFT framework listeners at suite start and finish.

Allure CLI resolution (always managed Allure 3): after allure-bom 3.0.0 (#5793 / #5798 / #5801), SHAFT never activates a user-installed allure binary on PATH for generate/open/serve — including Allure 2.x. Report generation uses the configured Allure 3 CLI in this order:

  1. Maven-provisioned / engine-bootstrapped portable CLI under ~/.m2/repository/allure/allure-cli/&lt;allure3Version&gt;/ (override root with -Dallure.cli.cacheRoot=...) → node &lt;cli.js&gt;.
  2. npx on PATH → npx --yes allure@&lt;allure3Version&gt;.
  3. Portable Node.js under ~/.m2/repository/nodejs/ → its bundled npx → same npx --yes allure@&lt;version&gt; invocation.
Provision prefers unpacking the Maven zip io.github.shafthq:allure-cli:&lt;version&gt;:zip (#5815) into the runtime cache when the artifact is present locally, then falls back to npm. Air-gap CI: mvn -Pprovision-allure-cli-maven -pl shaft-engine -am initialize. Online warm-up: mvn -Pprovision-allure-cli -pl shaft-engine -am initialize. The allure.forceConfiguredCliVersion property remains a deprecated always-on alias (setting it false only logs that PATH allure is ignored).

Thread safety: all public methods are static and intended to be called from a single thread (the test runner thread). The result directory fields are mutable class-level state and should not be accessed concurrently.

  • Method Details

    • initializeAllureReportingEnvironment

      public static void initializeAllureReportingEnvironment()
      Initialises the Allure reporting environment before a test suite begins. This method:
      1. Resolves the Allure results folder path from SHAFT properties.
      2. Optionally cleans the report and results directories.
      3. Writes convenience shell/batch scripts to the project root for manual report generation.
      4. Writes the current JVM system properties to environment.xml in the results directory.

      The Allure 3 CLI is resolved (and downloaded if necessary) automatically at report-generation time; no separate installation step is required.

      Example (called automatically by SHAFT listeners): 

      AllureManager.initializeAllureReportingEnvironment();

    • openAllureReportAfterExecution

      public static void openAllureReportAfterExecution()
      Generates the Allure HTML report and opens it in the default browser when SHAFT.Properties.allure.automaticallyOpen() is true. The generated report is copied to the allure-report directory, renamed (optionally with a timestamp when accumulateReports is enabled), and the intermediate output directory is deleted.

      Example (called automatically by SHAFT listeners after suite completion): 

      AllureManager.openAllureReportAfterExecution();

    • generateAllureReportArchive

      public static void generateAllureReportArchive()
      Generates a self-contained ZIP archive of the Allure report when SHAFT.Properties.allure.generateArchive() is true. The archive is written to the project directory with a timestamped filename (e.g. generatedReport_2024-01-15_10-30-00-000.zip).

      This method is a no-op when archive generation is disabled in properties.

      Example (called automatically by SHAFT listeners): 

      AllureManager.generateAllureReportArchive();

    • allureCliCacheRoot

      public static String allureCliCacheRoot()
      Returns the Maven-local cache root for pinned Allure 3 CLI installs (#5801).

      Default: ~/.m2/repository/allure/allure-cli/. Override with -Dallure.cli.cacheRoot=/custom/path/ (trailing separator optional).

      Returns:
      absolute cache root directory path ending with the platform separator

    • tryProvisionAllureCli

      public static boolean tryProvisionAllureCli(String allure3Version)
      Best-effort install of the pinned Allure 3 CLI into the Maven-local runtime cache (#5801/#5815). Prefers a local Maven zip unpack, then npm. Safe to call when already installed (no-op). Does not use a user PATH allure binary.
      Parameters:
      allure3Version - pinned Allure 3 npm package version
      Returns:
      true when cli.js is present after this call
